items.title: Mrs. Charlotte Botney and Mrs. Bertha George McCullum Interview, 1960-10-16
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Do you remember going down to the dances that Buddy Bolton played? [INTERVIEWEE] No, they didn't allow me to go to dances.

ctx.x: That would be two years after you were married. Yeah, mm-hmm. That's what I'm telling you. I don't know too much about him. He didn't rather play music with George, because George didn't play that time.
Do you remember going down to the dances that Buddy Bolton played?

No, they didn't allow me to go to dances. That's things. They didn't allow me to go to dances. I was in school. I went to the big picnics. Yes. And George would come and ask my uncle. The same uncle taught him music if I was living with them. And I'm down even school in the country. And he'd tell them, no, all the clubs, and I'd think, I'll bring her there. You'll see her at the dance. Will they bring the dance? Girls didn't run the streets like they do now.
